Khamoshi ko aagyanta, shaanti ko swikaar, aur daayaluat ko kamzori mat samjho.

Khamoshi rooh ko theek karti hai.
Sher khamoshi se ladta hai.
Bade kaamon mein waqt lagta hai.
Apni mission par kabhi na rukna.

Khamoshi thoughts ke beech ki saans hai.
Himmat matlab jo sahi, woh karna.
Himmat darr ka ek minute aur tikna hai.
Grit sthir hai.
Jo tum ho aur jo tum chahte ho—difference action hai.
Khamosh dimag jhelte hain.
Dard aur takleef se hi sabse majboot aatmaayein nikalti hain.
Himmat tootne se inkaar hai.
Himmat hamesha cheekhti nahi.
Khamoshi uljhe hue dimag ko saaf karti hai.
